svg.title: Metadata-Driven Architecture on Fabric
svg.desc: A metadata contract describing sources and load rules is resolved into per-object configuration, which a single reusable Data Factory pipeline and reusable notebooks execute against Fabric compute. Each run writes data into a lakehouse and records state, quality, and lineage telemetry in a run ledger; the ledger both proves what happened and supplies the watermark the next run reads to stay restartable. Two warning nodes call out where this pattern breaks: an over-grown metadata schema that turns into an untyped programming language, and non-idempotent writes that corrupt data on retry.
svg.text: Metadata-driven architecture: govern once, resolve per object
One reusable pipeline, driven by a versioned contract

g.title: Versioned metadata contract — Object list, source, target shape, quality rules, load type — versioned like code.
g.text: Source · target shape · rules · load type

g.title: Config resolution — Turns the generic contract into one object's concrete run parameters.
Reusable pipeline invocation — One parameterized Data Factory pipeline drives every object instead of one pipeline per source.
g.text: for every object — not one pipeline

g.title: Pipeline run instance — Each trigger produces one concrete, individually monitorable run.
Reusable notebook transform — Object-agnostic transform logic runs once per object, parameterized the same way as the pipeline.
Lakehouse landing (Delta) — Data lands as managed Delta tables, auto-registered and immediately queryable.
g.text: Same target contract for every object.

g.title: Quality evidence — Contract-defined rules are evaluated against the landed data and recorded as evidence.

g.aria-label: Run ledger / state store in OneLake
g.title: Run ledger / state store — Records what happened, and holds the watermark the next run needs.
g.text: Status · rows written · watermark · contract version — one row per run, stored in OneLake

g.title: Lineage & telemetry — Source-to-output lineage and monitoring signals captured for governance.
g.text: source object → contract version → run ID → Delta table → quality result

svg.text: captured via Purview scan of lakehouse items

g.aria-label: Warning: metadata becomes a hidden language
g.title: Metadata becomes a hidden language — An over-flexible contract stops being config and starts being undocumented code.
g.text: If the contract grows loops, branches, and nested
rule expressions, govern it like code: schema, review,

g.title: Non-idempotent retry corrupts data — Retrying a failed write without watermark discipline duplicates or corrupts committed rows.
g.text: A blind rerun that ignores the ledger's committed
Fabric Codex — original diagram, July 2026. Vendored Microsoft Fabric icons used unchanged (Data Factory, Lakehouse, Notebook, OneLake); composition and connectors are original.
